text:
These hilltop retreats are some of Phuket's most romantic crash pads Now Live thanks to sublime panoramic Andaman Sea views and the island's most discreet staff. All villas include swimmable pools and roomy decks for sun and shade. The 360 bar attracts the island's best dressed inhabitants who flock here at sundown for the calm view then stay
sipping colorful cocktails late into the warm night.
